Enter the SSID manually. Comet 2.4.3 has no network scan route, and this app never saves the Wi-Fi password.
This sends the manually entered SSID and password once. It can move Comet to another network and immediately drop this connection. The password is cleared locally and the write is never replayed.
This stops Wi-Fi and deletes Comet\'s saved SSID and password. It may immediately drop this connection, and an ambiguous response is never replayed.
